recs.title: Your 10 recommended actions
items: Post the 'If you have it, we buy it' card today (block c below), leading with the Trimble TX8, SX12 and Emlid RS4 Pro. The RS4 Pro and MALÅ RFPs expire 9–10 Oct. All 11 live RFPs are at 0 offers.

Celebrate the FARO Premium 200 sale (Switzerland → USA, 7 Oct) with an anonymous 'Sold' post on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn. The last post was 5 Oct (the SX12 wanted post), and it got 0 comments.
Welcome the new Belgian seller's 5 Topcon HiPer kits (listed 6 Oct) in a 'New in: Topcon GNSS' carousel. They're the freshest stock on the site.

Send the weekly Odoo campaign. Two 'This Week at Topotrade: New Listings & Offers' mailings are still drafts. The last sends (24 Sep) opened well: OAGQ 560 recipients, 13.9% click rate; INTERGEO 109 recipients, 16.5% click rate.
INTERGEO follow-up wave: on 7 Oct Mireille and Georges sent about 40 personal follow-ups. Add the 109-contact 'Intergeo 2026' list to the weekly newsletter so they get the listings.
Instagram is flat: topotrade_ has 758 followers and 622 posts; digitalrealities.fr has 72. Reuse the sold/wanted cards as Reels/Stories (reach data isn't available through the API).

Website tracking: GA4 recorded 0 conversions on 6–7 Oct (31 active users on 7 Oct, mostly Direct). Make sure the RFP-post and sign-up events fire, and add UTM tags to every social and newsletter link so leads can be traced in Odoo.
Google Ads is still at $0 (card declined since 1 Sep). Draft a 'Sell your instrument' + 'Wanted' campaign so it's ready when Zein fixes billing.

Digital Realities: Matterport now sells the Pro3 directly in France at €3,695 HT. Prepare a DR post on what DR adds (stock in France, scanning services, rental, support). Agree the angle with Daniel and Zein.
DR Facebook (30 followers) and GA4 (0 sessions on 7 Oct) are very low. Plan two DR posts a week, reusing the 29 Sep and 5 Oct 3D-scan posts as a series.
